parsed.text: This packet contains fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3 in two panels (p0, p1). Copied-prior or completed current records are not new conditional estimates, and conditional command records (k0,k1,k2) are alternative, not executed, branches. Current estimates: most current node distributions are uniform ties across all 16 cells (p0 and p1 nodes n0–n2 and many others); in panel p0 current n3 blue peaks at [1,0] and red peaks at [1,2]. Conditional differences: many candidate views keep n0 and n1 uniform; p0 n2 candidates typically concentrate blue at [0,2] and red at [0,1] (k0,k2) or both at [0,2] (k1). Panel p1 n2 shows distinct candidate patterns: k0 places blue mass on [0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3] and red on [0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]; k1 concentrates blue [0,2], red [0,1]; k2 at p1 n2 is uniform. Across panels, many candidate n3 entries repeat blue [1,0] and red [1,2].
